pages.text:
Money-back policy
Customers can return purchases within thirty days and receive their payment back in full.

Account recovery
If you cannot remember your login secret, request an emailed link to choose a new one.

Service disruptions
When our platform goes offline, engineers are paged immediately and a status notice is posted.

Delivery times
Parcels typically arrive within five business days after leaving our warehouse.

Personal information handling
We never sell the details you share with us to advertisers.

Ending your subscription
You may terminate your plan at any time from the billing screen without penalty.

Join our team
We are hiring engineers and designers for remote positions across many countries.

Developer interface
Programmatic access lets software read and write your records using authenticated requests.

Plans and cost
Three tiers are available, billed monthly or yearly.

Environmental commitment
Our data centers run on renewable electricity.
